title: Reductive annealing assisted enhanced oxygen vacancies in MgGa2O4 spinel towards improved OER and HER electrocatalysis
content:
Sustainable Energy Fuels, 2025, Advance Article
DOI: 10.1039/D5SE00793C, Paper
Reshmi T. Parayil, Sangeeta Jangra, Santosh K. Gupta, Kalpana Garg, K. Sudarshan, M. Mohapatra, Tharamani C. Nagaiah
Efficient MgGa2O4 bifunctional electrocatalysts with oxygen vacancies were developed under reducing atmosphere, showing enhanced HER and OER activity, high current densities, low overpotentials, and excellent stability for overall water electrolysis.
